commitResults.messageBody:
Consolidate task insertion, persistence, and confirmation in one
private helper so the three public add methods express only their
task-specific construction. Rename temporary values to describe their
contents and update the UI test plan to use the date formats accepted by
the current Date model.

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove trailing UI error whitespace
commitResults.messageBody:
Keep numbered-command error messages free of trailing spaces so the
console output is easier to read and compare exactly. The change also
keeps these messages consistent with the other command validation
responses without changing their wording or control flow.

Add update command to edit task descripiton
commitResults.messageBody:
Tasks cannot be edited once updated.
But users might need to change the descriptions later.

Format: update <task_number> <new_description>

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse optional update fields
commitResults.messageBody: Allow update commands to contain a description, deadline, event start,\nend time, or any combination of those fields. Preserve omitted values by\nrepresenting them as absent parsed fields for the task layer.

commitResults.messageTitle: Preserve omitted task update fields
commitResults.messageBody: Rebuild todo, deadline, and event tasks with only the fields supplied by\nthe user. Keep existing metadata and completion state when fields are\nomitted, and reject fields that do not apply to the selected task type.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle update fields without descriptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Recognize field markers at the beginning of an update command so users can
change only an event boundary or deadline without repeating the description.

commitResults.messageTitle: Support partial updates across task types
commitResults.messageBody:
Allow CLI and GUI users to replace descriptions, deadlines, and event
boundaries independently or together. Extend parser tests and the UI test
plan to verify preserved fields, completion state, and invalid updates.

commitResults.messageTitle: Correct partial update test expectations
commitResults.messageBody:
Record the intermediate event state produced when a full event update is
followed by a from-only update. Keep the UI test plan aligned with the
actual command output so future regressions are detected.
